==English==
{{wp}}
[[File:US $20 Series 2006 Obverse.jpg|thumb|right|Banknote of the United States]]

===Etymology===
{{etymon|en|:af|bank<id:institution>|note<id:remark>}}
From {{compound|en|bank<id:institution>|note}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈbæŋknəʊ̯t/|/ˈbæŋkˌnɵ̞ʊ̯t/|a=RP}}
* {{IPA|en|/ˈbæŋkˌnoʊ̯t/|/ˈbæŋkˌnɔʊ̯t/|a=GA,non-æ-tensing}}
** {{IPA|en|/ˈbeɪ̯ŋkˌnoʊ̯t/|/ˈbeɪ̯ŋkˌnɔʊ̯t/|a=æ-tensing}}
*** {{audio|en|LL-Q1860 (eng)-Wodencafe-banknote.wav|a=US}}
* {{hyph|en|bank|note}}

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{senseid|en|Q47433}} A piece of [[currency]] made of [[paper]] or [[polymer]]. {{defdate|from 18th c.}}
#: {{syn|en|note<qq:ellipsis, especially in Commonwealth>|bill<qq:ellipsis, especially in North America>|flimsy<qq:slang>|long-tailed one<qq:slang for high denominations>}}
#: {{hypo|en|greenback#Noun}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|paper money<id:Q131938946><!--a banknote is a countable unit of paper money [noncount noun]-->}}
<!--sense Q47433 came from the sense below because Q47433 originally was literally a promissory note and it still is [[in a way]]-->
# {{senseid|en|promissory note issued by a bank}} {{lb|en|now|historical}} A [[promissory note]] issued by a bank, payable at a given time to a specific [[beneficiary]]. {{defdate|from 17th c.}}
#: {{hyper|en|promissory note|<|note<id:document promising payment>}}
#: {{nearsyn|en|bank paper<id:banknotes in circulation>}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1728|author=w:John Gay|title=The Beggar's Opera|section=I.4
|passage=Was Captain ''Macheath'' here this Morning, for the '''Bank-notes''' he left with you last Week?}}
